correctness.rationale: Checked original full Castillo–Liu arXiv:1710.01899 equations (4.1)–(4.3), Definition4.4 and Proposition4.6 for two-permutation vertices v_{pi,tau}=Σ_i[Mi+N(tau_{i-1}−tau_i)]e_{pi^{-1}(i)} for appropriate M,N. The N-summand telescopes and center is c=M(d+2)1/2; coordinates decompose a_i=i−(d+2)/2 and b_i=tau_{i-1}−tau_i. Sum a_i²=d(d+1)(d+2)/12 and sum a_i b_i=d(d+1)/2, leaving endpoint-zero path roughness E(tau)=Σ(tau_{i-1}−tau_i)². Uniform permutation sampling gives E[E]=(d+1)²(d+2)/6 and E-variance=(d−2)(d+1)²(d+2)(5d+11)/180 from identical, adjacent-overlap, disjoint path-edge products; independently exact-enumerated all permutations d=2..7, matching these formulas, including 0 iff d=2. Covariance by Sn permutation invariance has equal diagonal/off-diagonal, vanishes on 1, and trace=mean R², yielding (meanR²/d)(I−J/(d+1)). All dimensions d>=2 and only appropriate positive M,N, not full arbitrary nested deformations.
